messages:
zoe@redwood: Quick heads-up — found a small but blocking issue in the console observability examples for tracehook v3 migration.
marco@redwood: ok what's the blocker?
kai@redwood: tagging in case it affects SDK samples too @sam@redwood
zoe@redwood: the Python tracehook snippet still shows the old import and args. It 404s in the playground and fails the docs smoke check. Example currently: 
```python
from redwood.obsv import TraceHook

hook = TraceHook(api_key=... , trace_key='trace')
```
Should be `from redwood.observability import TraceHook` and `trace_key` renamed to `trace_id_key` per v3.
marco@redwood: ugh. I also noticed the dashboard YAML sample has an extra `-` under `panels:` so the yaml loader fails. Small fix but breaks the quickstart preview.
sam@redwood: I can patch the Node/TS snippets after the Python fix. Do we want to keep the old parameter as an alias for a release or just update docs and call it out?
kai@redwood: prefer short-term alias in the SDK (deprecation notice) + doc callout. Docs should show new param with a short note: `(old: trace_key)`. Keeps customers from breaking.
zoe@redwood: agreed. For this PR flow: Marco fixes the examples and yaml, I update copycalling out the param rename and add a tiny migration note, Sam updates TS/Node samples, Kai adds a one-line note to the SDK CHANGELOG. Can we do all as a single docs PR?
marco@redwood: I'll open a docs PR with all three sample changes + yaml fix. Ping me if you want separate commits.
docs-bot: PR draft created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6148 by marco@redwood :construction:
sam@redwood: I'll push the TS snippet changes to that PR as a follow-up commit, doing a quick smoke run against the playground preview.
kai@redwood: FYI, the smoke test should include: 1) preview build (netlify) 2) snippet execute for python and node 3) dashboard YAML parse. I can add a short action to the docs CI for the PR.
zoe@redwood: Can we aim to merge today? This blocks a customer demo tomorrow. If CI is green I'll approve.
marco@redwood: working on it now. Pushed python + yaml fix.
docs-bot: CI started for PR 6148 — checks: build, snippets-smoke, netlify-preview
sam@redwood: pushed TS examples and a tiny README note for migration.
kai@redwood: added docs-ci job for snippet execution (runs quick container + example run). Kicking it off on the PR.
marco@redwood: CI green on build & snippet-run, netlify preview pending.
zoe@redwood: reviewed copy, left one small phrasing nit about "per-token" -> "per-input-token" in the cost breakdown paragraph. Not blocking.
marco@redwood: fixed the nit, force-pushed.
docs-bot: PR 6148 merged by marco@redwood — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6148 :tada:
zoe@redwood: awesome — thanks all. I'll update the customer-facing migration note and send a short release email.
sam@redwood: will backport the TS snippets to the v2 branch tomorrow morning.
kai@redwood: logged a tiny SDK follow-up issue for the alias removal/compat handling.
marco@redwood: closing loop here. If anything else pops in preview, re-open the PR. :+1:
zoe@redwood: thanks — great cross-team sync. :rocket:
